//: Upstream files with fork lines, and every line the fork may add to each (indentation and blank lines ignored). Checked by .github/scripts/fork-seam-check.cjs against the base branch's copy of this file; see docs/fork/updates.md.

packages/contracts/src/settings.ts.why: Fork settings live in forkSettings.ts; settings.ts takes them with one spread per struct. automaticUpdates stays inline: upstream's pending setting has the same name and place.
added: * Fork: a boot-service server installs newer releases by itself once nothing is working.
* Same name and place as upstream's pending automatic-updates setting, whose line replaces this
* one when it lands (upstream defaults it on). A file saying `autoUpdateServer` is renamed on load.

packages/shared/src/serverSettings.ts.why: A settings patch's fork fields are applied by forkSettingsPatch.ts, by the rules in forkSettings.ts.

apps/server/src/serverSettings.ts.why: Every settings write goes through upstream's patch and write paths here. The fork swaps in its patch (fork/serverSettingsPatch.ts, under upstream's name, so a project's MCP profile a client left out is kept) and calls its save check (fork/serverSettingsWriteCheck.ts) once in each write path. The load decodes the file after fork/settingsFileRead.ts (old auto-update names renamed, an unusable interval left out so it reads as its default). The lines from "import { renameRetiredAutoUpdateKeys }" on predate this list and record main as it was when every upstream file began to count (#277); they are to move into apps/server/src/fork/ (follow-up), and the file cannot grow meanwhile.

//forkFiles: Files upstream does not have that are not named as fork files (a fork, fork-*, forkName or FORK_* folder or file).
